erp40_unmasked_421_inc_guided.root_cause: Deterministic C++ THROW_CHECK abort inside worker thread during MatchGuided on pair (1, 10) (pano_00000.jpg <-> pano_00018.jpg), which is the first ERP pair classified by 4.2.1 spherical homography estimation (#4054) as TwoViewGeometryConfiguration.PLANAR_OR_PANORAMIC (config=6, has_E=True, has_F=False, has_H=True). In 4.1.0 all 780 pairs were config=2 (CALIBRATED); in 4.2.1 586 pairs are CALIBRATED and 194 pairs are PLANAR_OR_PANORAMIC. PR #3935 fixed guided matching only for CALIBRATED (pair (1,2) and pair (1,12) succeed with guided_matching=True), whereas PLANAR_OR_PANORAMIC on EQUIRECTANGULAR has F=nullopt and throws inside the worker thread.
